purpose: Lock the reviewed glibc world objects and locale members; not the complete world reconstruction manifest.
inclusion_rule: Accepted base rows from glibc classified WORLD_CORE_SUBSTRATE or DATA_CAPABILITY_PROVIDER.
excluded_scope: Headers, static/start files, administration tools, undeclared NSS/gconv modules and loader-state files.

purpose: Lock reviewed non-world provider objects required by the base Obsidian X11 graph.
inclusion_rule: Accepted base rows excluding glibc world/data rows.
excluded_scope: Application-local payload, GTK data, fonts, pixbuf/icons/MIME and unselected package members.

purpose: Lock incremental reviewed provider objects for the accepted Freedreno graphics feature path.
inclusion_rule: Conditional rows with graphics capability or GRAPHICS profile pressure.
excluded_scope: Unselected libdrm backends/tools, generic Vulkan stacks and package-wide extension surfaces.

purpose: Lock reviewed GTK/font/device/Wayland compatibility objects without admitting them to the X11 base.
inclusion_rule: Conditional rows with GTK, font, device, udev or Wayland pressure.
excluded_scope: Fonts, pixbuf modules/cache, icons/MIME, libwayland-server, wayland-scanner and unselected package members.

purpose: Lock reviewed printing dependency objects while printing capability remains optional.
inclusion_rule: Conditional rows carrying electron.printing.cups or PRINTING profile pressure.
excluded_scope: Printing service/provider itself, Kerberos administration tools, filesystem tools and unselected plugins.

purpose: Lock libtermux-exec.so as an optional platform integration provider.
inclusion_rule: Exact termux-exec-glibc member only; inclusion requires a named failing child-exec transition.
excluded_scope: Default minimum runtime until necessity is demonstrated.
